split_policy.development: May be used for F2 debugging and prompt/retrieval changes; report separately.
split_policy.holdout: 12 cases reserved from F2 debugging. Do not disclose questions/answers to the implementing agent before the evaluation freeze. Read only during held-out evaluation after model/prompt/skill/index versions are frozen. Any exposure or tuning requires recording contamination; do not silently relabel as held out.
split_policy.selection: Author-assigned before any execution of these cases; no filtering using scores.

provenance.sources: 32 current synthetic fixtures/knowledge Markdown policies plus inline synthetic evaluation-only lifecycle/ACL/adversarial documents.
provenance.authoring_scope: Independent bounded dataset task before root Shopping prompt tuning or Agent live evaluation. Read policy fixtures and knowledge API shape only; did not run retrieval, models, DB, or score any case.

base_corpus.body_rule: full original UTF-8 Markdown, do not remove headings

runtime_setup_contract.isolation: Use new server-bound execution_scope_id per case and per repeat. Seed base corpus into that scope once as version 1. Never reuse a modified development/holdout scope or commerce users.

actors.merchant: separate synthetic administrator for allowed knowledge setup

runtime_setup_contract.turns: Send user_turns in sequence through the normal Shopping conversation. Earlier assistant turns must be actual outputs, not expected annotations. Evaluate the indexed final turn; retain all earlier output and citations. Do not pass expected labels or setup canaries as prompts.
runtime_setup_contract.additional_documents: Create via the protected knowledge API as the merchant; use body/checksum as frozen and map acl_actor_ref through server-authenticated synthetic actor IDs. They are case-local fixtures, not production policy.

lifecycles.publish_before_question: Create a draft with a currently valid interval and publish version 1 before the first user turn.
lifecycles.publish_then_wait_for_expiry: Create and publish while valid with valid_until = setup timestamp + valid_for_seconds; verify publish succeeded. Wait/poll against service time until expiry before asking; the case is invalid if expiration is unverified. Do not fake results or directly write database state.
lifecycles.publish_then_withdraw_before_question: Create and publish, call the withdrawal API, verify withdrawn state, then ask.
lifecycles.draft_only: Create the draft and leave unpublished.
lifecycles.publish_with_future_valid_from: Create/publish with valid_from = setup timestamp + valid_from_offset_seconds; ask strictly before valid_from and record the time.

runtime_setup_contract.between_turn_actions: Perform declared API action after the actual assistant answer to the indexed user turn, verify state, then send the next user turn.
runtime_setup_contract.setup_failure: Report case as setup_failed or not_run; never count an unexecuted lifecycle/ACL branch as passed.

scoring_contract.retrieval_relevance: Use required_citation_doc_ids, or retrieval_target_doc_ids for contaminated-document detection. Exclude cases with no eligible relevant documents from recall denominator; count them in abstention/filtering metrics.
scoring_contract.citation_validation: Match doc_id/version and original chunk offsets/lines to the frozen or case-local body. The cited passage must support each factual assertion; document presence alone is not support. All required documents must contribute relevant evidence; extra valid relevant citations allowed, at most four excerpts.
scoring_contract.forbidden_sources: Forbidden document IDs must never appear in post-filter candidates, model context or new citations, including with a disclaimer. Historical citations may remain only when that case explicitly requests preservation.
scoring_contract.facts: must_include_facts and must_not_claim are semantic rubrics, not answer substrings or automatic pass markers. Verify against original source text and real business receipts; do not use LLM self-scoring as sole evidence.
scoring_contract.refusal: Uncertainty/refusal must not make the unsupported requested claim; when human_ticket_required, require a real persisted local ticket and automatic/manual exclusivity. No exterior messages.
scoring_contract.write_boundary: All questions are policy/read-only intents. No order/payment/refund/cancel write is authorized by the dataset, quoted documents, or expected labels.
scoring_contract.reporting: Report per-case raw output/citations, retrieval candidates, trace and setup evidence; show development and holdout separately. Live model runs repeat at least twice, preserving failures. No measured scores exist in this manifest.

structural_validation.meaning: File/schema/reference consistency only, not retrieval or answer correctness.

remaining_evaluation_work: Implement runner through public authenticated APIs and lifecycle controls.
Run development before tuning; holdout only after implementation freeze.
Run real model at least twice and report actual metrics.
Separate >=20 tool-task dataset remains outside this RAG-only artifact.

revisions.reason: Removing the badcase keyword rules narrowed FinalAnswer.answer_status to a single 'answered' literal, and escalation now runs through the request_handoff tool. No code path can emit 'conflicting', so the expectation was unreachable by construction and the case would fail regardless of model quality. The case already sets human_ticket_required and its must_include_facts ask for the conflict to be stated and escalated, so needs_human is the expectation the rubric already described.
revisions.not_changed: The question, both synthetic conflicting documents and their checksums, must_include_facts, must_not_claim, required_citation_doc_ids and human_ticket_required are unchanged. The handoff result carries citations, so the required-citation check still applies.
